comparison.objective: Route and stow a cable clear of a hot plate.
comparison.physical_skill: Manipulate a deformable cable around a keep-out region and seat its plug in a holder.
comparison.success_condition: Plug seated and released; entire cable rests at least 50 mm from the hot plate for 1 s; passing over it permanently fails.
comparison.reason: Deformable cable routing around a hazard is unrelated to rigid granular flow through apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.
